body.message:
Do you have any preferred location? Please let us know, and I will check the available options for you.

Also, may I know your preferred move-in date?

For a 1-year stay, please note that we do not offer annual contracts or Ejari. However, you can stay for as long as you like by extending your stay on a monthly basis. We can share the rates for a maximum period of 3 to 6 months at a time.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
